UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and preferences within the Nexus AI application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This typically corresponds to the Firebase Authentication User ID.

preferredDisplayMode.description: The user's preferred mode for displaying financial explanations and data. 'Essential' provides simplified explanations, 'Full' provides technical data.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: Represents a financial asset manually registered by a user, including its type, quantity, and storage location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Asset entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity that owns this asset. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Asset)

name.description: The human-readable name of the asset (e.g., 'Vale', 'Bitcoin').

tickerSymbol.description: The ticker symbol or short code for the asset (e.g., 'VALE3', 'BTC').

assetType.description: The category or type of the financial asset (e.g., 'Stock', 'Cryptocurrency', 'Real Estate Fund', 'Bond').

quantity.description: The quantity or number of units of the asset owned by the user.

averagePurchasePrice.description: The average price at which the asset was purchased per unit.

storageLocation.description: The platform or location where the asset is held (e.g., 'Binance', 'Ledger', 'XP Investimentos').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the asset record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the asset record was last updated.

GlobalIntelligenceAlert.title: GlobalIntelligenceAlert
GlobalIntelligenceAlert.description: Stores a predictive financial alert generated by the Nexus AI, including its causal explanation, market signals, and explanations tailored for different user modes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GlobalIntelligenceAlert entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this intelligence alert was generated by the Nexus AI.

title.description: A concise title summarizing the alert.

eventOrigin.description: The primary category of the global event triggering the alert.

causalityExplanation.description: A detailed explanation of the causal link between the global event and its predicted impact on financial assets.

priority.description: The priority level of the alert, ranging from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

marketAction.description: The recommended market action based on the alert.

riskLevel.description: The overall risk assessment associated with the market signal.

affectedAssetTickerSymbols.description: An array of ticker symbols for assets identified as being affected by this alert.

essentialText.description: A simplified explanation suitable for 'Essential' display mode.

fullLocationRiskAnalysis.description: Analysis of asset risk based on storage location.

MarketPrice.title: MarketPrice
MarketPrice.description: Real-time market price for a specific ticker symbol, updated by the Nexus engine.

definition.description: A global hub for AI-generated predictive financial alerts.
Real-time market data feed for various assets.

firestore.reasoning: A estrutura de dados foi expandida para incluir a coleção /market_prices, permitindo o ciclo Fetch-Push-Listen solicitado. O uso de caminhos planos otimiza a performance do onSnapshot e simplifica as regras de segurança para dados públicos/globais.
